6ffeabec24:
How is the Gundam doing?
Is that circuit I gave you working well?
73ec2e03a0:
I see, of course it is.
With that, the Gundam's combat power will jump several times over.
e775b8a0ce:
All right, next attach this to the memory circuit.
This one I developed with reference to
the circuits of the Titans' mobile suits.
544e9795ee:
The Gundam's weakness was that it couldn't fly,
but with this, any mobile suit at all
will be able to fight in the air.
742eef28c3:
It's amazing!
A mobile suit's air superiority will jump several times over.
Take it. And attach it and test it right away.
55ed59be63:
(Somehow it feels like Father's oxygen deprivation
 has gotten worse... Did he hit his head somewhere?)
96515c811b:
Hurry!
You're a soldier now too, aren't you!
c2b03767e3:
Anyway, if I shoot down as many enemies as I can,
Father should be satisfied...
12785c85b2:
A few years after the end of the One Year War,
Amuro Ray visited his father, Tem Ray,
who was still recuperating on Earth.
d55b1dea59:
Tem Ray's integrated circuits were outdated and useless.
But Amuro hoped that by showing what he could do in
the air, he might ease his father's condition a little...
438df7b6ae:
This area is a timed battle.
Defeating enemy battleships and enemy aces
extends the time limit.
8cc4532bcb:
You can clear it without shooting down 10,000,
but keep extending the time limit
and try for 10,000 kills!
db1a537e9c:
Bah, forget the battleships! Show the mobile suits!
Show how the mobile suits fight! Yes, yes, like that.
Bah, Amuro, what are you doing!?
8a074a48c1:
Yes, good!
That's a mobile suit I designed!
0458a2e487:
We won, we won!
That's the power of my new part!
There's plenty of use left in me yet!
c872d7b2dc:
We can win, Earth Federation Forces!
Long live the Federation! Hooray! Hooray!
e773943915:
Watching the results on the TV broadcast, Tem Ray
was convinced it was all thanks to his parts,
and threw himself into further research.
9afb391cb6:
But the fruits of that research
never saw the light of day...
